# KIPSMTHN Creative Platform - LLMS.txt

## Platform Overview
KIPSMTHN Creative Platform is a comprehensive SaaS solution built for creative professionals to manage galleries, clients, contracts, and business operations. Built with Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, and deployed on Vercel.

## Public Sections (Accessible Without Authentication)

### 1. Home Page
- URL: `/`
- Description: Landing page introducing the platform, key features, and value proposition for creative professionals
- Content: Hero section, feature overview, testimonials, call-to-action for sign-up

### 2. About Page
- URL: `/about`
- Description: Company information, mission, vision, and team details
- Content: Company background, core values, team bios, contact information

### 3. Work/Portfolio Showcase
- URL: `/work`
- Description: Public portfolio showcasing sample galleries and creative work
- Content: Curated gallery displays, case studies, client success stories

### 4. Services Page
- URL: `/services`
- Description: Overview of services offered through the platform
- Content: Service categories, pricing information (where applicable), service descriptions

### 5. Contact Page
- URL: `/contact`
- Description: Contact information and inquiry form
- Content: Contact form, business address, phone/email, social media links

### 6. Privacy Policy
- URL: `/privacy`
- Description: Data protection and privacy policy
- Content: GDPR/CCPA compliance information, data handling practices, user rights

### 7. Sign-Up Page
- URL: `/sign-up`
- Description: User registration page for new accounts
- Content: Registration form, terms of service acceptance, email verification process

### 8. Sign-In Page
- URL: `/sign-in`
- Description: User authentication page for existing accounts
- Content: Login form, password recovery, social login options (when available)

### 9. Public Gallery Access
- URL: `/public/galleries/[slug]`
- Description: Publicly shareable galleries via secure links
- Content: Gallery viewing experience, media display, basic interaction (comments/likes when enabled)
- Access: Token-based or slug-based public sharing

### 10. Public Contract Access
- URL: `/public/contracts/[token]`
- Description: Publicly accessible contracts for review and signing
- Content: Contract viewing, electronic signature workflow (when implemented)
- Access: Secure token-based access

### 11. Health Check Endpoint
- URL: `/api/health`
- Description: System health monitoring endpoint
- Content: JSON response indicating system status, version, and basic metrics
- Access: Publicly accessible for monitoring purposes

## Authentication-Protected Sections (Require Login)

### Dashboard
- URL: `/dashboard`
- Description: User dashboard with key metrics and quick access
- Content: Badge counts, recent activity, financial overview, navigation to all features

### Gallery Management
- URL: `/app/galleries`
- Description: Complete gallery creation, management, and organization
- Features: Upload, watermarking, theming, approval workflows, client sharing

### Client Management
- URL: `/app/clients`
- Description: Customer relationship management
- Features: Client profiles, communication history, project tracking

### Contract Management
- URL: `/app/contracts`
- Description: Legal agreement creation and management
- Features: Templates, e-signature workflow, renewal tracking, audit trails

### Financial Management
- URL: `/app/financial`
- Description: Invoicing, quotes, and financial tracking
- Features: Invoice generation, payment tracking, revenue reporting

### Settings
- URL: `/app/settings`
- Description: User preferences and account configuration
- Features: Profile management, notification preferences, billing information

## Technical Stack
- Frontend: Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- Backend: Next.js API Routes, Drizzle ORM with PostgreSQL (Neon)
- Storage: Vercel Blob for media assets
- Authentication: Clerk (email/password, with planned social login)
- Email: Resend (planned integration)
- Payments: Stripe (planned integration)
- Infrastructure: Vercel hosting with automatic SSL

## Key Features Available
- Gallery creation and management with media upload (images/videos)
- Watermarking and theming capabilities
- Client relationship management
- Contract creation and management
- Invoice and quote generation
- Dashboard analytics and reporting
- Public sharing via secure links
- Approval workflows for client collaboration
- Role-based access control ( ownership verification )

## API Endpoints (Select Public Ones)
- GET `/api/health` - Health check
- GET `/api/public/galleries/[slug]` - Public gallery data
- GET `/api/public/contracts/[token]` - Public contract data
- POST `/api/webhooks/clerk` - Clerk authentication webhooks (Svix verified)

## Data & Content Types
- Galleries: Collections of images and videos with metadata
- Media Assets: Uploaded images (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP) and videos (MP4, MOV)
- Clients: Customer records with contact information and project history
- Contracts: Legal agreements with templates and e-signature capability
- Invoices: Billing documents with payment tracking
- Services: Service catalog with descriptions and pricing

## Accessibility & Performance
- Built with accessibility considerations (WCAG 2.1 AA target)
- Optimized for performance with Next.js automatic code splitting
- Image optimization via Next.js Image component
- Responsive design for mobile, tablet, and desktop
- Target: <2s page load time, <200ms API response time

## Security & Compliance
- SOC 2 Type 2 compliance in preparation
- Authentication via Clerk with session management
- Ownership verification for all data access
- Input validation and sanitization on all user inputs
- Rate limiting on sensitive endpoints (especially uploads)
- Environment variables managed through Vercel
- No sensitive data stored in client-side code

## Current Development Phase
- Phase 1: Foundation & Stability (Current - Next 2 Months)
  - Focus: Stabilize implementation, address technical debt, establish foundations
  - Current work: Rate limiting implementation, input validation standardization, test coverage improvement

## Documentation & Support
- Comprehensive user documentation available in-platform
- API reference documentation (in development)
- Troubleshooting guides and runbooks
- Changelog maintained for release tracking
- Community support and feedback channels
